description: Defines an event listener for drag-and-drop operations on ImageView components in an Android app, handling visual feedback and updating images based on drop events.

classes.name: ImageDragListener
classes.description: Implements the View.OnDragListener interface to handle drag events on ImageViews, changing background colors and setting images upon drop.

methods.name: onDrag
methods.description: Handles drag events, updates view background colors based on the event phase, and processes drop events to set images.

methods.name: setTargetColor
methods.description: Sets the background color of the target view to provide visual feedback.

methods.name: processDrop
methods.description: Processes the drop event, retrieves the URI from the ClipData, and updates the ImageView with the dropped image.

methods.name: processLocation
methods.description: Placeholder method for processing drag location; currently does nothing.

methods.name: setImageUri
methods.description: Sets the image URI for an ImageView when a drag-and-drop operation with a URI is completed.
